hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.md|*.mdx|*.markdown) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "${f##*/}" in README.md|AGENTS.md|CLAUDE.md) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */.claude/skills/*) exit 0 ;; esac; root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$f" in /*) case "$f" in "$root"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac ;; esac; if [ -e "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "Blocked: this repo adds no new markdown files. The code is the only source of truth, so put the reason in a name, a type or a test. Editing an existing .md is fine, and README.md, AGENTS.md and agent skills under .claude/skills/ are the exceptions." >&2; exit 2; }
